title: Additional Safety Measures and Penalties for Demolition Works
what_it_is: Additional Safety Measures and Penalties for Demolition Works

sections.label: Demolition safety, penalties, executive accountability
sections.summary: MOM investigates the incident, issued a Stop Work Order, cites SS 557, and states penalties and executive WSH requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM is investigating the incident and had issued a full Stop Work Order to the occupier of the worksite.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: There is an Approved Code of Practice – Singapore Standards SS 557 – that sets out standards of practice for the safe demolition of buildings and structures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As investigations are ongoing, we will review if any additional measures are required beyond those in SS 557 and after the investigations have concluded.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Penalties under the Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) Act are calibrated based on the culpability of the offender and the severity of harm.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Higher-risk activities such as demolition works require greater extent of risk assessment and preventive measures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Hence, incidents involving such higher-risk activities would generally attract more severe penalties, if the individual and/or company failed to demonstrate that reasonable steps had been taken to minimise the risk.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Chief Executives (CEs) will be required to personally account to MOM for serious WSH lapses following incidents, as was the case for the Tanjong Pagar incident.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: CEs and Board Directors of all companies in higher-risk industries are also required to attend a new Top Executive WSH Programme.

sections.label: BCA inspections and company safety duties
sections.summary: BCA sends officers for inspections on an inspection basis, while companies must have safety officers and procedures under the Code and regulations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I am aware that BCA does send its officers down for inspections but given the many demolition works that go on, from the big buildings to the Addition & Alteration (A&A) works, home renovations, for example, it is not possible to have officers all over, so they do this on inspection basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But under the Code and under regulations, the companies involved should have safety officers and safety procedures in place.
